title: docs(skills): lookupAutofill copies a currency amount only between fields in the same currency
body:

Fixes #36349
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；读「数据建模」技能的 AI 助手现在知道，选取关联记录时金额只在两边币种相同的情况下才会自动带出，不同币种时目标字段保持原值并说明原因，平台不做换算。
- 为什么做：这是「选产品不跨币种抄价格」那项改动欠下的技能文字，替按技能写应用的 AI 助手补上，免得它继续承诺一定会带出价格。
- 出错会怎样：只是技能里的两句说明、一处指引和几处表格用词，不影响任何运行行为；可以直接撤回这一个合并。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, the `lookupAutofill` paragraph. It ended at the sentence about the grid's same-named `autofill` copy and stated no currency condition. Two sentences are appended there, covering the declared pair and the same-named copy together:

> Either copy moves a `currency` amount only between fields in the same currency (`fixed` or per-record); else the target is left as it was and the form says why. Nothing is converted.

This is what the merged code does (`crossCurrencyRefusal` and `judgePickWrites` in `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupAutofill.ts`, used by the record form and by the grid's `planLookupAutofill`; the spec describe of `FieldSchema.lookupAutofill` states the same rule for both copies).

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, the "Catalog auto-fill" bullet (the grid's same-named copy), now ends "picking a record fills those cells (a `currency` amount only in the same currency: field-types.md → `lookupAutofill`)": a pointer to the sentence above instead of a second statement of the rule. It fits that file's headroom (4180 to 4202 of 4203 tokens); nothing was deleted there.

`field-types.md` sat at its token ceiling (3541 of 3541), so its sentences are paid for in the same file, by deletion and with no ceiling moved:

- the paragraph's own example is shortened from the full pair literal to "`unit_price` from a product's `list_price`" (the heading already spells the pair shape), and "(single-value `lookup` / `master_detail`)" becomes "(single-value only)" (the table rows directly above name the two types);
- fourteen "When to Use" cells that only restated the type name lose the restating words: `date`, `time`, `datetime`, `number`, `file`, `markdown`, `html`, `richtext`, `boolean`, `signature`, `location`, `avatar`, `tags`, `slider` keep a shorter cell with the same meaning (for example "Date only (no time component)" is now "Date only").

Published-skill size, measured at `b01d8f97e9` (before) and `a141c91fb2` (after): `rules/field-types.md` lines 267 / 270; `rules/field-types.md` tokens 3541 / 3540 (ceiling 3541); `rules/relationships.md` tokens 4180 / 4202 (ceiling 4203); whole `skills/` tree lines 22996 / 23000; whole bundle tokens 294236 / 294257.

A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/skills` is included: the skill text ships in that package.

Read first: the appended sentence (the risk is a promise the runtime does not keep); then the trimmed table cells (the risk is a lost hint).

## Tests

## Acceptance notes

- The card's wording is "the target stays empty". The merged code leaves the target as it was: empty on a fresh line, and holding its earlier value on a re-pick or an `overwrite: true` pair. The sentence says "left as it was" so that it promises only what the runtime does.
- "The same currency" also covers two amounts that both sit in the home currency (neither declares one), which copy as before.
- The rule also has finer cases the sentence does not spell out (a target whose record holds no code yet, a parent code that could not be read): each is the same outcome, target left as it was with a stated reason.
- The grid's catalog auto-fill bullet points at the field-types sentence rather than restating it. The grid leaves a refused cell as it was and shows a note under the line (`planLookupAutofill`'s `withheld` list, drawn by `GridFieldWidget`).

`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `field-types.md 3540 / 3541 (-1)` and `relationships.md 4202 / 4203 (-1)` and ends with a line starting with a check mark.
